e.title: torchvinecopulib
e.summary: PyTorch 藤 copula 库（251★）：GPU 加速的 vine copula 拟合与采样
e.body: torchvinecopulib（TY-Cheng/torchvinecopulib，251★）是用 PyTorch 实现的高维 vine copula 拟合与采样库：借助 GPU/自动微分，支持大维度数据上的 C/R/D-vine 结构选择、参数估计与条件采样。对 RIAA：高维相依建模的现代（GPU）实现——巨灾多险种组合、多风险因子聚合（[[copula-r]]/[[pyvinecopulib]] 的 PyTorch 替代）；与 [[copulas-jl]]（Julia 侧）互补；配 [[concentrationmetrics]] 做分散度分析。
e.verified_note: repo 页核实：PyTorch vine copula 拟合/采样库，251★
e.summary_en: PyTorch vine-copula library (251★): GPU-accelerated vine-copula fitting and sampling
e.summary_hk: PyTorch 藤 copula 庫（251★）：GPU 加速的 vine copula 擬合與採樣
e.body_en: torchvinecopulib (TY-Cheng/torchvinecopulib, 251★) is a library for high-dimensional vine-copula fitting and sampling built on PyTorch: leveraging GPU and automatic differentiation, it supports C/R/D-vine structure selection, parameter estimation and conditional sampling on large-dimensional data. For RIAA: a modern (GPU) implementation of high-dimensional dependence modelling — for multi-line catastrophe portfolios and multi-risk-factor aggregation (a PyTorch alternative to [[copula-r]]/[[pyvinecopulib]]); complements [[copulas-jl]] (Julia side); pair with [[concentrationmetrics]] for diversification analysis.
e.body_hk: torchvinecopulib（TY-Cheng/torchvinecopulib，251★）是用 PyTorch 實現的高維 vine copula 擬合與採樣庫：借助 GPU/自動微分，支持大維度數據上的 C/R/D-vine 結構選擇、參數估計與條件採樣。對 RIAA：高維相依建模的現代（GPU）實現——巨災多險種組合、多風險因子聚合（[[copula-r]]/[[pyvinecopulib]] 的 PyTorch 替代）；與 [[copulas-jl]]（Julia 側）互補；配 [[concentrationmetrics]] 做分散度分析。
